                   Table "public.orders"
  Column   |   Type    | Collation | Nullable |   Default   
-----------+-----------+-----------+----------+-------------
 order_id  | bigint    |           | not null | generated a.
           |           |           |          |.lways as id.
           |           |           |          |.entity
 customer_.| integer   |           | not null | 
.id        |           |           |          | 
 qty       | integer   |           | not null | 1
 price     | numeric   |           | not null | 
 total     | numeric   |           |          | generated a.
           |           |           |          |.lways as (q.
           |           |           |          |.ty::numeric.
           |           |           |          |. * price) s.
           |           |           |          |.tored
 during    | tstzrange |           |          | 
 referrer_.| integer   |           |          | 
.id        |           |           |          | 
Indexes:
    "orders_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (order_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
    "no_overlap" EXCLUDE USING gist (customer_id WITH =, during WITH &&)
Check constraints:
    "orders_case_check" CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN qty > 10 THEN price < 100::numeric
    ELSE true
END)
    "orders_qty_check" CHECK (qty > 0) NO INHERIT
    "price_pos" CHECK (price > 0::numeric) NOT VALID
Foreign-key constraints:
    "orders_customer_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES app.customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    "orders_referrer_fk" FOREIGN KEY (referrer_id) REFERENCES app.customers(id) MATCH FULL ON UPDATE SET NULL
